name: Zang Hua - Anhei Taohuayuan
source: A man who lost his purpose in life enters a deep forest in a mountain region. He happens upon a strange cave, on the other side of which lies a mysterious village where everything looks as if frozen in time, completely unchanged since 2000 years ago. The people here are very friendly and hospitable, and the girl he encounters upon entering the village is of dazzling beauty... But what secrets can hide in this peaceful place? And why is it against the rules to leave your house at night?
translation: 一个失去人生目标的男人进入了山区的密林。他偶然发现了一个奇怪的山洞，山洞的另一边是一个神秘的村庄，那里的一切看起来都仿佛被时间冻结了，自2000年前以来，一切都没有任何变化。这里的人们非常友善好客，进村时遇到的女孩更是美得耀眼……但这片宁静的地方到底隐藏着什么秘密呢？为什么晚上离开家是违法的？
